healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Lusha connector. Returns the connector health status.

person.enrich.title: Enrich Person
person.enrich.description: Enrich a single person's contact data using Lusha's /v2/person endpoint. Provide at least one lookup identifier: email address, LinkedIn profile URL, or a combination of firstName + lastName + companyName/companyDomain. Returns verified contact emails and phone numbers.

email.description: The person's email address to look up.

linkedinUrl.description: The person's LinkedIn profile URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/johndoe).

firstName.description: The person's first name. Use together with lastName and companyName or companyDomain.

lastName.description: The person's last name. Use together with firstName and companyName or companyDomain.

companyName.description: The company name associated with the person. Use with firstName + lastName.

companyDomain.description: The company domain (e.g. acme.com) associated with the person. Use with firstName + lastName.

person.description: The enriched person data including emails and phones.

company.enrich.title: Enrich Company
company.enrich.description: Enrich company data using Lusha's /v2/company endpoint. Provide a company domain or company name to retrieve firmographic data including industry, size, revenue, location, and social profiles.

domain.description: The company's website domain (e.g. acme.com). Preferred over companyName for accuracy.

companyName.description: The company's name. Used when domain is not available.

prospecting.contact.search.title: Search Prospecting Contacts
prospecting.contact.search.description: Search for contact prospects using Lusha's prospecting engine via POST /prospecting/contact/search. Filter by name, job titles, seniorities, departments, locations, company domains, and company sizes. Returns a requestId and contact stubs for subsequent enrichment.

name.description: Optional. Full or partial name to search for.

jobTitles.description: Optional. List of job titles to filter by (e.g. ["VP of Engineering", "CTO"]).

seniorities.description: Optional. Seniority levels to filter by (e.g. ["VP", "Director", "C-Level"]).

departments.description: Optional. Department names to filter by (e.g. ["Engineering", "Sales"]).

locations.description: Optional. Geographic locations to filter by (e.g. ["United States", "New York"]).

companyDomains.description: Optional. Company domains to restrict search to (e.g. ["acme.com"]).

companySizes.description: Optional. Company size buckets to filter by (e.g. ["11-50", "51-200"]).

page.description: Optional. Page number for pagination (1-indexed, default 1).

size.description: Optional. Number of results per page (max 100, default 10).

requestId.description: Request ID used to enrich the returned contacts.

prospecting.contact.enrich.title: Enrich Prospecting Contacts
prospecting.contact.enrich.description: Reveal full contact details (emails and phone numbers) for contacts returned by a prospecting search, using POST /prospecting/contact/enrich. Requires the requestId from a prior search and the contactIds to reveal.

requestId.description: The requestId returned by a previous prospecting.contact.search call.

contactIds.description: List of contact IDs (from the search results) to reveal contact details for.

contacts.description: Array of enriched contact objects with emails and phones.

prospecting.company.search.title: Search Prospecting Companies
prospecting.company.search.description: Search for company prospects using Lusha's prospecting engine via POST /prospecting/company/search. Filter by company name, domains, sizes, industries, and locations. Returns a requestId and company stubs.

name.description: Optional. Company name to search for.

domains.description: Optional. List of company domains to filter by (e.g. ["acme.com"]).

sizes.description: Optional. Company size buckets to filter by (e.g. ["51-200", "201-500"]).

industries.description: Optional. Industry names to filter by (e.g. ["Software", "Financial Services"]).

locations.description: Optional. Geographic locations to filter by (e.g. ["United States", "California"]).

page.description: Optional. Page number for pagination (1-indexed, default 1).

size.description: Optional. Number of results per page (max 100, default 10).

requestId.description: Request ID used to enrich the returned companies.

prospecting.company.enrich.title: Enrich Prospecting Companies
prospecting.company.enrich.description: Reveal full company details for companies returned by a prospecting search, using POST /prospecting/company/enrich. Requires the requestId from a prior company search and the companyIds to reveal.

requestId.description: The requestId returned by a previous prospecting.company.search call.

companyIds.description: List of company IDs (from the search results) to reveal full data for.

companies.description: Array of fully enriched company objects.

bulk.person.title: Bulk Enrich Persons
bulk.person.description: Enrich multiple people in a single API call via POST /v2/person. Each contact in the batch can be identified by contactId, email, linkedinUrl, fullName, companyName, or companyDomain. Returns enriched contact data for each entry.

contacts.description: Array of contact lookup objects. Each must have at least one identifier.

contactId.description: Optional. Your internal reference ID for the contact.

linkedinUrl.description: Optional. The contact's LinkedIn profile URL.

companyName.description: Optional. The company name for name-based lookups.

companyDomain.description: Optional. The company domain for name-based lookups.

requestId.description: Lusha request ID for the bulk operation.

usage.get.title: Get Usage / Credits
usage.get.description: Retrieve current API credit usage and remaining balance from Lusha via GET /credits. Returns the number of credits consumed and remaining for the current billing period. Note: endpoint assumed to be /credits based on Lusha API documentation.

credits.description: Credit usage details including used, remaining, and limit.

contacts.search.title: Search Contacts
contacts.search.description: Find contacts by identifier via POST /v3/contacts/search. Look up to 100 contacts by id, linkedinUrl, email, or firstName + lastName + companyName/companyDomain, and return non-PII previews with the has and canReveal data points.

contacts.description: Contact identifiers (1-100). Each item requires at least one of id, linkedinUrl, email, or firstName + lastName + companyName/companyDomain.

data.description: V3ContactsSearchResponse with requestId, results, and billing.

contacts.enrich.title: Enrich Contacts
contacts.enrich.description: Reveal full contact data for up to 100 contact IDs returned by a search via POST /v3/contacts/enrich. Use reveal to unlock emails and/or phones, and pass tableId to persist the revealed contacts to a Lusha table.

ids.description: Lusha contact IDs from a prior search (1-100).

reveal.description: Data points to reveal. Omit to reveal both.

waterfallEnabled.description: Allow this call to fall through to enabled third-party providers when Lusha has no match.

tableId.description: Optional. Add the revealed contacts to this Lusha table.

data.description: V3ContactsEnrichResponse with requestId, results, billing, and an optional async job.

contacts.search_and_enrich.title: Search and Enrich Contacts
contacts.search_and_enrich.description: Find contacts and reveal their full data in a single call via POST /v3/contacts/search-and-enrich. Provide identifiers as in Search Contacts and use reveal to control which fields are unlocked.

contacts.description: Contact identifiers (1-100). Each item requires at least one of id, linkedinUrl, email, or firstName + lastName + companyName/companyDomain.

reveal.description: Data points to reveal. Omit to reveal both.

data.description: V3ContactsSearchAndEnrichResponse with requestId, results, and billing.

contacts.prospecting.title: Prospect Contacts
contacts.prospecting.description: Filter-based contact search via POST /v3/contacts/prospecting. Apply rich filters across title, seniority, location, and signals, with pagination; pass tableId to also persist matches to a Lusha table.

filters.description: Prospecting contact filters (title, seniority, location, signals, ...).

tableId.description: Optional. Persist matching results to this Lusha table.

options.description: Optional controls such as includePartialProfiles, excludeDnc, and maxContactsPerCompany.

data.description: V3ProspectingContactsResponse with requestId, pagination, results, and billing.

account.usage.title: Get Account Usage
account.usage.description: Retrieve current credit usage, rate limits, plan details, and pricing from GET /v3/account/usage.

data.description: AccountUsageResponse with credits, rateLimits, plan, and pricing.

companies.filters.values.title: Get Company Filter Values
companies.filters.values.description: Fetch valid values for a company prospecting filter type via GET /v3/companies/prospecting/filters/{filterType}. Filter types include sizes, revenues, locations, industriesLabels, technologies, and intentTopics.

filterType.description: Company filter type, e.g. sizes or industriesLabels.

query.description: Optional search text to narrow the returned values.

data.description: FilterValuesResponse with a values field whose shape depends on the filter type.

subscriptions.create.title: Create Subscriptions
subscriptions.create.description: Create webhook subscriptions (bulk supported, up to 25 items) via POST /api/subscriptions. Provide shared defaults (HTTPS webhook URL, entity type, signal types) and one entry per entity to watch.

defaults.description: Shared subscription defaults; url is required.

subscriptions.description: Subscriptions to create (1-25). Each item requires entityId and may override entityType, signalTypes, and name.

data.description: CreateSubscriptionResponse with total, successful, failed, and per-subscription results.

subscriptions.list.title: List Subscriptions
subscriptions.list.description: List webhook subscriptions via GET /api/subscriptions with limit/offset pagination.

subscriptions.get.title: Get Subscription
subscriptions.get.description: Retrieve one webhook subscription by ID via GET /api/subscriptions/{id}. The webhook secret is never returned by this endpoint.

subscriptions.update.title: Update Subscription
subscriptions.update.description: Update a webhook subscription's URL, name, signal types, or active state via PATCH /api/subscriptions/{id}. Set regenerateSecret to rotate and return a new webhook secret.

signalTypes.description: New signal types to subscribe to.

regenerateSecret.description: Generate a new webhook secret, returned in the response.

subscriptions.delete.title: Delete Subscriptions
subscriptions.delete.description: Delete webhook subscriptions (bulk supported, up to 25 IDs) via POST /api/subscriptions/delete. The response reports per-ID success and failure.

data.description: DeleteSubscriptionResponse with total, successful, failed, and per-ID results.

audit_logs.list.title: Get Audit Logs
audit_logs.list.description: List webhook delivery audit logs via GET /api/audit-logs, optionally filtered by subscription ID or delivery status, with limit/offset pagination.

data.description: AuditLogsResponse with delivery log data and pagination.

audit_logs.stats.title: Get Audit Log Statistics
audit_logs.stats.description: Retrieve webhook delivery statistics (total, success, failed, success rate) via GET /api/audit-logs/stats, optionally filtered by subscription ID.

data.description: AuditLogStatsResponse with total, success, failed, and successRate.
